criteria.text: Schema: Add run_episode_id column to agent_run_outcomes table (SQLite migration + Postgres bootstrap)
Repository: Update AgentRunOutcomesRepository.finalizeAsync to accept and persist run_episode_id
Service: recordTerminalOutcome passes the computed runEpisodeId to the repository
Promotion/Judgement: Filter outcomes by valid receipt existence — only runs with a matching agent_org_treatment_receipts row for the same run_episode_id count toward cohort statistics
criteria.reason: Implemented as a new repository capability (AgentRunOutcomesRepository.listReceiptBackedByExperimentAsync) proven by RED->GREEN tests to correctly join/filter on run_episode_id against agent_org_experiment_treatment_receipts. NOT wired into the existing judgeExperimentAsync/computeDecisionAsync production call sites in this slice: the tracking issue #1448 explicitly splits that wiring into separate future phases ("C3: Judgement/adjudication gated by receipts" and "C4: Promotion gated by receipt-filtered outcomes", both listed as "Not started"). Wiring it into computeDecisionAsync now would silently change interim results/decision counts for ~20 pre-existing tests across 3 files (org_proposal_experiment_service.test.ts, org_proposal_experiment_collecting.test.ts, experiment_cohort_wiring_contract.test.ts) that seed outcomes without receipts today — out of this slice's bounded scope. Recorded as a scoping decision, not a gap: the capability exists, is tested, and is additive-only.
